comments.body:
Shortened the comment to two lines (018ad6f4).

On line 68: it is reachable. `JSON.parse` succeeds for valid JSON that is not an object (`"yes"`, `[1]`, `null`), so `parsed_content.is_a?(Hash)` is false there, and the method-level `rescue` is what turns that `TypeError` into the `RuntimeError` that `perform_safe_judgement` handles. Without the guard, `parsed_content['explanation']` on a String or Array would raise a different error or return garbage. The tests added here cover non-JSON answers.

On requiring JSON: left as is in this PR; it depends on the chat vs responses endpoint question @frutik raised, so I would keep that for a follow-up.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
Okay, with the idea of _progress_ over _perfection_, I'm going to merge this.

> progress over perfection

this is the only reasonable way...
